description:
The pay range is $58,100.00 - $104,600.00 
 Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits . 
 
 About us: 
 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here .

 At the heart of one of the world’s best-loved and most recognizable brands is an impeccable Owned Brand Sourcing & Development organization. We thrive on the magic of discovering that just-right thing, and we infuse everything we do with our passion for affordable chic. We develop, make and deliver the stylish new favorites that Target guests expect and deserve. We stay ahead of the curve, proactively identifying our market’s needs and exceeding them, every time. Join one of our dynamic and inventive teams to influence the quality and value that decisively position Target above the competition. Your input will have a direct and positive effect. Here, you’ll be close to the action of dreaming up and bringing to life the Target-owned brands that surprise and gratify guests, wherever and whenever they love to shop.

 A role on our Product Development team means a big opportunity to start from scratch and create something truly original. Are you a product development professional who can support your business by staying one step ahead of industry trends? Can you demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and help develop products that stand out in the marketplace for their quality and value? Then you’ll find success on our Product Development team, which plays a critical role in bringing Target-owned brands to life. In close partnership with our design, merchandising and sourcing counterparts, you’ll drive brand cohesion and continuity, ensuring that our products meet merchant line plans, assortment strategies, price points and guest expectations.

 Responsibilities 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams (CFT) to research and develop guest-focused Owned Brand products from concept through production.
 Partner with Senior Technical Designers, Designers, Merchandising, Sourcing and Vendors to deliver on product objectives and business strategies while adhering to calendar timelines.
 In partnership with overseas technical design teams and vendors, create, maintain and complete accurate product specifications and approvals in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.
 Communicate regularly with internal and external partners to ensure high-quality execution in materials, components, construction and overall product performance.
 Perform fit evaluation on samples for fit, construction, and quality.
 Support in-cycle technical research, product testing, quality analysis, innovation and product solutions.
 Partner proactively with overseas technical designers, production engineers and vendors to identify and address potential manufacturing, quality and product development concerns throughout the development cycle.
 Assist in conducting market research to evaluate competitors, industry benchmarks and emerging opportunities to engineer value and develop cost-effective, high-quality products.
 Partner with guest insights and product testing teams to support research and testing that inform product development and foster inclusivity.
 Support vendor and production teams by reviewing production issues and collaborating with cross-functional partners to identify and implement solutions.
 Help establish, maintain and enhance product development guidelines and standards by category and brand.
 Participate in Technical Development team’s vendor training, onboarding, assessments and accreditation.
 Assist in building and maintaining product development resources, technical documentation and reference libraries.
 Perform other duties as required or assigned by manager.
 
 This role is performed in office 4 days/week from our Downtown MN campus. This is not a remote-eligible role. 

 About you: 
 Bachelor’s degree, associate degree or certification in technical design, product design, industrial design or a related field; equivalent hands-on experience in product development or a related industry will also be considered.
 0–4 years of experience in product development, technical design, manufacturing or a related industry.
 Knowledge of product construction, materials, specifications, manufacturing processes and quality standards is valued but not required.
 Proficiency in relevant computer applications, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Microsoft Office Suite and PLM systems; experience with 3D CAD software is a plus.
 Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
 Willingness and ability to learn and apply new technologies, tools and software relevant to the role.
 Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
 Ability to proactively troubleshoot, adapt and solve problems in a fast-paced, evolving and highly collaborative environment.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with and influence cross-functional partners.
 Commitment to continuous learning, diversity, equity and inclusion.
  
 This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target HQ MN location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target.
 
 
 
 
Team Members in the Target General Merch Inc operating company are prohibited from working more than thirty (30) days per calendar year in any of the following states: AL, AR, DE, FL, IN, IA, LA, MD, MS, MO, NC, OK, PA, SC, TN and VA. If hired, you will be prohibited from working remotely from any of the states listed above for more than thirty (30) days per calendar year. 
 
 Benefits Eligibility 
Please paste this url into your preferred browser to learn about benefits eligibility for this role: https://tgt.biz/BenefitsForYou_D 
 
 


 Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) 

 In compliance with state and federal laws, Target will make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please submit your request at target.com/targethr/hr-request . Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel. 
 
 
Application deadline is : 12/01/2026
